correctness.rationale: Exact analytic derivative follows from the absolutely convergent Fourier series and rational sums. The reciprocal sextic property plus the Hopf lemma on every non-endpoint boundary arc/gap and noncancellation at each of eight endpoints gives exactly three zeros inside counting multiplicity. The Joukowski reduction and cubic discriminant transfer count real versus conjugate nonreal zeros; the exceptional antipodal case is treated using a two-sheeted covering. Symbolic checker verifies polynomial identities and rational discriminants; numerical roots and series comparison support but do not substitute for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The problem models a canonical four-electrode Dirichlet boundary configuration. The exact real-axis equilibrium census for every admissible pair of mirror-symmetric arc centers and common width is a natural complete classification, with genuine nonantipodal parameter regimes of one versus three real equilibria and an interior collision. The antipodal square exhibits an explicit width-independent triple critical point. These are structurally informative bifurcation invariants, not a numerical instance or a renamed three-arc result.
